Issue #3796: [BUG] Live with empty render leaves behind a spurious newline Repository: Textualize/rich - [x] I've checked [docs](https://rich.readthedocs.io/en/latest/introduction.html) and [closed issues](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed) for possible solutions. - [x] I can't find my issue in the [FAQ](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/FAQ.md). **Describe the bug** When using a `Live` without anything that renders, it will leave behind a spurious newline despite setting `transient=True`. However, even a single empty string makes the newline go away. ```python from rich.live import Live from rich.console import Group list: list[RenderableType] = [] live = Live(Group(*list), transient=True) with live: pass exit(0) ``` The code above will leave behind a spurious newline (see screenshot). If I were to initialize `list` as `[""]`, the newline does not appear anymore. Some more details on the usecase: I use a live to render a varying number of elements indicating progress - once the task is done, the associated elements will go away as well. Consequently, at the end of my program, the list of renderables in the group is empty, and my code leaves behind a spurious newline. Always having the empty string as a "hack" is slightly annoying as well, since then during the Live display, there is always an additional empty line at the bottom of the screen - limiting the real estate. **Platform**
